screening_note: Aircraft stopped responding to control inputs; the record does not say whether the link was lost. Model is the M30 (no thermal), not the M30T. AAIB record-only list Apr-May 2025 (published 2025-07-10). Location: Gainsborough, Lincolnshire.
narrative: After approximately 10 minutes of flight, the UA stopped responding to control inputs from the remote pilot. A collision was heard, and the UA was subsequently found on the roof of a house.
